lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca2Fe8O16 (reduced formula Ca(FeO2)4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Ca centers adopt a close-packed-like 12-coordinate arrangement of O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Fe octahedra and face-sharing between Ca and Fe polyhedra are observed. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
